answer: Anchor each identity to one real bank account verified by micro-deposits: the network sends two tiny random amounts, and the owner must report both within a day. One account anchors one identity, so a farm wanting a hundred votes needs a hundred real bank accounts, each with KYC checks, fees, and a paper trail. A falcon-fast monitor watches the grove of linked accounts for shared names or addresses, and any cluster collapses to a single vote while its stake burns. Honest users verify once; the yarrow-small deposit keeps entry cheap but forgery expensive at scale.
